# StaffBoard

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** StaffBoard

## What it does

Shows detected server staff and possible vanished staff in a HUD list.

Description basis: [source review](https://github.com/Pan4ur/ThunderHack-Recode/blob/49c76bcc5a5e4fbd12b06305c09f0c8fb76c510b/src/main/java/thunder/hack/features/hud/impl/StaffBoard.java). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
